name: Netflix Minigolf
summary: What happens when you combine the best parts of mini golf with bits of pinball and Mario Kart, then add a Demogorgon or Young-hee to round things out? You get Netflix Minigolf, a chaotic take on the date-night favorite. Here, you and up to three friends can sink shots from your living room in over 60 courses based on Netflix favorites like Bridgerton, Squid Game, and Stranger Things — with no ads or in-game purchases.
